name: Jan "SP3ZN45" Berens
biography: Jan Berens aka SP3ZN45 has been a goon in the QM department for several years now and is working full time as a redteamer at alpitronic SLR the leading manufacturer for DC chargers in Europe. His background is security consulting and penetration testing for critical infrastructures and industrial installations in Europe. Doing mostly non publicly disclosed security research and mentoring of beginners in the security domain.
